name: ine
document_label: Mexican voter ID card (INE / IFE, credencial para votar)

fields.document_type: type of document exactly as printed on the card title
fields.address: street line of the domicile only
fields.colony: colonia as printed, without the postal code
fields.expiry_year: last year of the validity (VIGENCIA), four digits
fields.issue_year: AÑO DE REGISTRO, four digits only
fields.id_number: first line of the machine-readable zone on the back, starting with IDMEX

extra_instructions: The front and the back may come as two files, or both sides may appear on the same page, small and slightly tilted; read both sides. Copy values exactly as printed. curp and clave_elector must be read character by character (clave_elector is 18 characters: 6 letters, 8 digits, H or M, 3 digits). full_name is the printed name lines joined in order (paternal surname, maternal surname, given names). address is only the street line; colony is the colony line without the postal code; postal_code is the 5-digit code printed on that line; city is the municipality / city before the state; state is the state exactly as printed. issue_year is the four-digit AÑO DE REGISTRO only (ignore any two-digit code after it). expiry_year is the LAST year of VIGENCIA (e.g. 2026 - 2036 -> 2036). id_number is the first line of the machine-readable zone on the back, starting with IDMEX, without the characters after '<<'. If the back is not visible leave id_number empty.
